raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The patch adds a labelled 500-character Note textarea to step 4, with labels also added to Name and Phone. The API trims the note before checking length, so an over-long note fails validation before anything is created, and `note || null` stores an empty note as NULL. Inner line breaks are kept, and the admin card renders the note as escaped plain text with `whitespace-pre-wrap`."}
